summary: CH4 Natural Solutions Corp (a blank-check company) filed an 8-K reporting the effectiveness of its S-1 registration and completion of its initial public offering of 20,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit on May 4, 2026. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Underwriting agreement with Santander US Capital Markets LLC. The company also entered into warrant agreements and a letter agreement with its sponsor and insiders. Proceeds will be held in trust pending a business combination. What to watch: the 24-month deadline to complete an acquisition or face dissolution and redemption.
